'''Madilon''' was a type of metal that could be used to make [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] smaller in size.

==Description==
Madilon was a type of naturally-occurring alloy, which had a unique molecular structure that gave it high tensile strength, while retaining a large amount of elasticity. These properties meant that the alloy could withstand the stresses of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel, and so it was useful in the construction of hyperdrives. The amount of madilon required for a single hyperdrive was relatively small, but allowed the hyperdrive to be almost ten times smaller in size than one that did not contain madilon. Scientists were unable to develop a method for synthesizing madilon, so the only sources of it were the few planets in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that contained deposits of it.<ref name="GOI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>

==History==
Madilon was first discovered in [[10,000 BBY]]<ref name="GOI" /> and the use of the metal in hyperdrive production was pioneered by the [[Kumauri Empire]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Madilon became a principal component in hyperdrive construction and it allowed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to make longer jumps when traversing the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] network of [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacons]] but use of the metal was limited, due to the alloy's scarcity.<ref name="GOI" />

In [[85 BBY/Legends|85 BBY]], traces of madilon were discovered in rock and soil samples that were taken from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. When news of the discovery leaked out, prospectors flooded to Nyriaan in search of madilon. Eventually, a number of madilon mines were established on the planet and Nyriaan became a major exporter of the alloy.<ref name="GOI" />
